_comment: KNOBS live here. KEYS/SECRETS live in v2/.env. NOTE: any AGENTD_* env var STILL OVERRIDES a value here, so keep knobs OUT of .env or they win. Keys are Config field names (config.py), not AGENTD_* names.
_comment_google: Google moved to plugins/google/ (an MCP plugin) — no longer a hardcoded mcp_servers entry.
_section_models: The agent BRAIN (reasoning). Every model-bearing TOOL/SUBSYSTEM model lives in `plugins` below, NOT here.
_section_model_catalog: The MENU of models the desktop Settings > Models dropdowns offer — the source of truth for the picker. Each entry: {value: litellm 'provider/model' id, label: display name}. The UI shows only entries whose provider API key is set in v2/.env (add a key to unlock its models); your currently-configured models always appear regardless. Edit freely — add, remove, relabel.
_section_cost_efficiency: Brain ROUTING by need (default off => the one `model` above does every turn). enabled=true => the cheap `text_model` runs ordinary turns; escalate to `vision_model` ONLY when the context carries an image the brain must SEE (an ImageContent block, e.g. a read_image/screenshot result). GENERATING an image needs NO escalation — that's a tool call the text brain makes with text args. Once an image enters history it stays, so this becomes 'cheap brain until the first image, vision brain onward'. REQUIRES DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in v2/.env for the deepseek text_model (no failover configured => a missing key breaks text turns; set enabled=false to revert).
_section_plugins: THE control panel for every plugin + tool. A plugin is just a namespace + a set of tools; ALL knobs live on the tool (plugins.<plugin>.tools.<tool>.<knob>) — there is no plugin-level model/provider. enabled (plugin or tool level) toggles it off; model = the AI model a tool calls; provider = its backend/SDK/engine; plus any tool-specific knob. Resolves first-hit-wins: per-call > agent.toml tools[T].<knob> > this file's tools[T].<knob> > the tool's built-in default. `description` fields are ONLY for humans reading this file — the agent never sees them.
